top_signals.title: Philippine Economy Grows at Slowest Pace Since 2009 Ex-Covid
top_signals.summary: Philippine economic growth dramatically slowed in the second quarter, defying expectations of a pickup, as the protracted Middle East conflict stokes inflation and drags down consumer spending and investment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
